points.title: 童年启蒙
points.description: 1942年1月8日，斯蒂芬·霍金出生于牛津，这一天恰好是伽利略逝世300周年。他的父母弗兰克和伊莎贝尔都是牛津大学毕业生，家庭学术氛围浓厚。霍金从小就展现出对科学和数学的浓厚兴趣，尽管在学校的表现并不突出，但他的父亲希望他成为医学家，而霍金本人则对物理学更感兴趣。这段时期奠定了他对宇宙学的好奇心和探索精神。
points.descriptionEn: Born on January 8, 1942, in Oxford—coincidentally the 300th anniversary of Galileo's death—Stephen Hawking grew up in an academic family. His parents, Frank and Isabel, were both Oxford graduates. Hawking showed early interest in science and mathematics, though not outstanding in school. His father hoped he would become a medical doctor, but Hawking himself was more drawn to physics. This period laid the foundation for his lifelong curiosity about cosmology.

points.title: 学术奠基
points.description: 1962年，霍金进入剑桥大学三一学院攻读博士学位，师从著名宇宙学家丹尼斯·西阿玛。正是在剑桥，霍金被诊断出患有肌萎缩侧索硬化症(ALS)，医生预测他只能再活两年。面对这一打击，霍金一度陷入抑郁，但最终重新振作，专注于研究。1965年，他完成了博士论文，研究黑洞和宇宙学，提出了霍金辐射理论的早期雏形，这一理论后来成为他最重要的贡献之一。
points.descriptionEn: In 1962, Hawking entered Trinity College, Cambridge, for his PhD under renowned cosmologist Dennis Sciama. It was in Cambridge that he was diagnosed with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), with doctors giving him only two years to live. Facing this prognosis, Hawking fell into depression but eventually rallied, focusing on his research. In 1965, he completed his PhD thesis on black holes and cosmology, developing early ideas for what would become his theory of Hawking radiation—one of his most significant contributions.

points.title: 理论突破
points.description: 1974年，霍金做出了他职业生涯中最重大的理论突破——提出霍金辐射理论。这一理论表明黑洞并非完全'黑'，而是会辐射粒子并逐渐蒸发，挑战了当时认为黑洞只吸收物质不释放能量的观点。同年，他被选为英国皇家学会会员，年仅32岁。1979年，霍金被任命为剑桥大学卢卡斯数学教授，这一职位曾由艾萨克·牛顿和保罗·狄拉克担任，标志着他在学术界的崇高地位。这一时期，他的身体状况持续恶化，几乎完全瘫痪，但他的理论研究却达到了新的高度。
points.descriptionEn: In 1974, Hawking made his most significant theoretical breakthrough: proposing Hawking radiation. This theory demonstrated that black holes are not entirely 'black' but emit particles and gradually evaporate, challenging the prevailing view that black holes only absorb matter. The same year, he was elected to the Royal Society at age 32. In 1979, he was appointed Lucasian Professor of Mathematics at Cambridge, a position previously held by Isaac Newton and Paul Dirac, marking his esteemed status in academia. During this period, his physical condition deteriorated further, leaving him almost completely paralyzed, yet his theoretical research reached new heights.

points.title: 科普巨匠
points.description: 1988年，霍金的科普著作《时间简史》出版，迅速成为全球畅销书，被翻译成40多种语言，销量超过1000万册。这本书以通俗易懂的方式解释了宇宙学、黑洞、大爆炸等复杂概念，使普通读者也能理解深奥的物理学理论。霍金开始频繁出现在媒体上，成为科学界的明星。1988年，他获得沃尔夫物理学奖。1992年，他的传记电影《霍金的故事》上映。这一时期，霍金借助语音合成器进行交流，虽然行动受限，但他的影响力却超越了学术界，成为全球科学普及的象征。
points.descriptionEn: In 1988, Hawking's popular science book 'A Brief History of Time' was published, quickly becoming a global bestseller translated into over 40 languages with sales exceeding 10 million copies. The book explained complex concepts like cosmology, black holes, and the Big Bang in accessible terms, allowing general readers to understand profound physics theories. Hawking began frequent media appearances, becoming a scientific celebrity. In 1988, he received the Wolf Prize in Physics. In 1992, the biographical film 'Hawking' was released. During this period, Hawking communicated using a speech synthesizer, and despite his physical limitations, his influence extended beyond academia, becoming a symbol of science communication worldwide.

points.title: 晚年探索
points.description: 进入21世纪，霍金继续在宇宙学领域进行探索，提出了一系列关于宇宙起源和命运的新理论。2002年，他发表演讲质疑黑洞信息悖论，认为信息不会在黑洞中丢失。2006年，他修正了自己对黑洞的观点，承认信息可能从黑洞中逃逸。2007年，他体验了零重力飞行，实现了童年梦想。2010年，他参与制作了纪录片《霍金的大设计》，探讨宇宙的起源。2012年，他70岁生日时，剑桥大学举办了庆祝活动。2014年，他的传记电影《万物理论》上映。2018年3月14日，霍金在剑桥家中去世，享年76岁，与爱因斯坦同一天逝世。他的去世标志着科学界一位巨星的陨落，但他的理论和思想将继续影响后世。
points.descriptionEn: Entering the 21st century, Hawking continued exploring cosmology, proposing new theories about the origin and fate of the universe. In 2002, he questioned the black hole information paradox, suggesting information might not be lost in black holes. In 2006, he revised his views on black holes, acknowledging that information could escape from them. In 2007, he experienced zero-gravity flight, fulfilling a childhood dream. In 2010, he participated in the documentary 'The Grand Design,' exploring the origins of the universe. In 2012, Cambridge University celebrated his 70th birthday. In 2014, the biographical film 'The Theory of Everything' was released. On March 14, 2018, Hawking died at his home in Cambridge at age 76, coincidentally on the same day as Einstein's death. His passing marked the loss of a scientific giant, but his theories and ideas continue to influence future generations.

appraisal.zh: 霍金被科学界视为当代最伟大的理论物理学家之一，霍金辐射彻底改变了人们对黑洞的理解，而他在重病中展现的毅力与《时间简史》的科普成就，使他成为连接科学与公众的象征。也有研究者指出，他的一些理论推测性较强、缺乏实验验证，在黑洞信息悖论上的立场屡有变化，科普中偶有过度简化，其名人地位也可能掩盖其他同样有才华的科学家。
appraisal.en: Hawking is regarded by the scientific community as one of the greatest theoretical physicists of his time: Hawking radiation transformed understanding of black holes, and his perseverance amid severe illness and the success of A Brief History of Time made him a bridge between science and the public. Some researchers note that certain theories were speculative and lacked experimental verification, that his position on the black hole information paradox shifted repeatedly, that his popular writing sometimes oversimplified, and that his celebrity may have overshadowed equally talented scientists.

supporter.zh: 霍金被科学界视为当代最伟大的理论物理学家之一，他的霍金辐射理论彻底改变了人们对黑洞的理解。尽管身患重病，他展现了非凡的毅力和对科学的执着追求。霍金不仅是一位杰出的科学家，还是一位杰出的科普作家，他的《时间简史》让深奥的宇宙学知识普及到大众。他证明了人类精神的力量可以超越身体的局限，激励了无数人追求科学梦想。
supporter.en: Hawking is regarded by the scientific community as one of the greatest theoretical physicists of our time. His theory of Hawking radiation revolutionized our understanding of black holes. Despite his severe illness, he demonstrated extraordinary perseverance and dedication to science. Hawking was not only an exceptional scientist but also a brilliant science communicator, making cosmology accessible to the general public through 'A Brief History of Time.' He proved that the power of the human spirit can transcend physical limitations, inspiring countless people to pursue scientific dreams.

critic.zh: 一些批评者认为霍金的某些理论过于推测性，缺乏足够的实验验证。还有人指出他在黑洞信息悖论上的立场多次改变，显示出理论的不确定性。此外，霍金在科普工作中有时过度简化复杂的科学概念，可能误导公众。也有批评者认为他的名人地位有时掩盖了其他同样有才华但知名度较低的科学家的工作。尽管如此，这些批评并不否定他在理论物理学领域的开创性贡献。
critic.en: Some critics argue that Hawking's theories are too speculative and lack sufficient experimental verification. Others point out his changing positions on the black hole information paradox, indicating theoretical uncertainty. Additionally, in his science communication, Hawking sometimes oversimplified complex concepts, potentially misleading the public. There are also criticisms that his celebrity status sometimes overshadowed the work of other equally talented but less well-known scientists. Nevertheless, these criticisms do not negate his pioneering contributions to theoretical physics.

objective.zh: 在历史和流行文化中，霍金已成为科学坚韧精神的象征。他代表了人类面对逆境时的不屈精神，同时也是一个连接科学与大众的桥梁。霍金的轮椅和语音合成器已成为他标志性的形象，象征着身体与精神的分离。他的理论工作虽然有时受到争议，但无疑拓展了人类对宇宙的理解边界。霍金不仅在科学领域留下深远影响，也在文化层面成为激励无数人的偶像，体现了科学探索的人文价值。
objective.en: In history and popular culture, Hawking has become a symbol of scientific resilience and perseverance. He represents the indomitable human spirit in the face of adversity while serving as a bridge between science and the general public. His wheelchair and speech synthesizer have become iconic symbols, representing the separation between physical body and intellectual spirit. While his theoretical work has sometimes been controversial, it undoubtedly expanded our understanding of the universe. Hawking has left a profound impact not only in science but also as a cultural icon who has inspired countless people, embodying the humanistic value of scientific exploration.

self.zh: 记住要仰望星空，而不是低头看脚下。尝试理解你所看到的，并追寻宇宙存在的原因。
self.en: Remember to look up at the stars and not down at your feet. Try to make sense of what you see and wonder about what makes the universe exist.
